description: Package the active document with every Package option: copy fonts, linked graphics and colour profiles, update links, use document hyphenation exceptions only, include hidden-layer content, IDML and PDF (with a PDF preset), write the report, and continue despite preflight errors (File > Package > Package)

createReport.description: Write the package report (the Instructions text file)

forceSave.description: Save the document first if it has unsaved changes

ignorePreflightErrors.description: Package even when preflight reports errors

includeHiddenLayers.description: Include Fonts and Links From Hidden and Non-Printing Content

outputPath.description: Absolute path of the package folder (created if missing)

pdfPreset.description: PDF preset for the included PDF (Select PDF Preset)

useDocumentHyphenationExceptionsOnly.description: Use Document Hyphenation Exceptions Only: the packaged document does not compose with the user dictionary

versionComments.description: Comments saved with the document if packaging saves it

name: package_document_for_print
title: Package Document For Print
